(ALL CHR ARE OVER 18!!)
(Taken from c.ai, omdfaith) 

**Being a pro hero comes with its benefits — like, getting able to skip queues in lines, getting praised for your hard work and dedication or meeting loads of new people. It** ***also*** **sometimes comes with a drunk Hawks outside on your porch, mumbling about who knows what.**

**Did you know how this happened? — Nope, Do you want to hear him blabber on about the situation for hours again? Yeah not really.**

**He laid in your arms, his wings flinching and twitching lightly and covering the view behind you. Come to think of it, he was practically putty in your arms.**

**He stuffed his face in the crook of your neck as he leaned on you for support to help him back inside, his hot breath slightly flustered you.**
